name: Sana
tagline: Enterprise AI assistant that searches and acts across your tools.
description: Sana is an enterprise AI assistant and agent platform from Stockholm-based Sana Labs that answers questions, drafts documents, and runs multi-step automations grounded in a company's own data. It connects to 100+ business applications, respects native permissions, and pairs a knowledge assistant and enterprise search with its Sana Agents and Sana Learn products. It's available on web and iOS, with a free tier and paid team and enterprise plans.
insight: Workday agreed to acquire Stockholm-based Sana Labs for about $1.1B in 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Connects to leading LLMs and 100+ company apps.

edge: Answers, drafts and runs multi-step agents over your real company data across 100+ connected tools with native permissions — not the public web.
